name: dedotcrawl
what: calms the crawling checkerboard that composite video leaves along colour edges: luma is averaged over neighbouring frames only where it changes little from frame to frame (TemporalSoften on luma, scene changes excluded); moving picture and the chroma are untouched
when: colour edges show a fine checkerboard that crawls or flickers while the picture there stands still
softens: grain and faint slow movement in still areas (they are averaged over time too); the threshold must be above the crawl's strength and no higher
tried_on: none of the owner samples has this defect, so it was created artificially on an owner cartoon cut: a luma checkerboard on colour edges flipping every frame: luma error 2.23 -> 0.86 at medium (1.15 at light), guard passed; ffmpeg's dedot in dot-crawl mode did less (1.53). Not yet tried on a real composite source
